warnings: IFCT 2017 has no iodine data; food iodine in the app is estimated and shown as approximate.
Do not take iodine, kelp or 'thyroid support' supplements above 500 µg/day without a doctor (ATA 2013); upper limit 1,100 µg/day (NIH).
Sea, rock, black and Himalayan pink salt are usually not iodised; check the pack.
Thyroid disease, pregnancy, breastfeeding, amiodarone use or recent iodine contrast: follow your doctor's advice; the app sets no iodine target on its own.
Shellfish iodine value (0.7-2.5 mg per 100 g, one old abstract) is suspect and not used.
